children: South Korea's Financial Services Commission and Korea Securities Depository are laying the groundwork to bring stocks, bonds, and funds onchain, powered by Avalanche. The program covers issuance, trading, clearing, settlement, and investor rights, placing Avalanche at the center of a government-led tokenization effort in one of the world's larger capital markets.

The involvement of the FSC and KSD gives the program regulatory and depository backing, meaning tokenized securities would carry defined investor rights rather than sitting outside the existing framework. For Avalanche, this positions AVAX as core infrastructure for national-scale tokenization instead of a single pilot or private test.

Execution across the full post-trade chain is the practical measure here. Progress on clearing and settlement, where most tokenization projects stall, will show whether the program reaches the scale its scope implies.
